<b>Kindanirs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Verdanians|Verdanian]] children who defend their lands from birth.<ref>Kindanir Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Child of Verdania, fully capable to fight despite its young age. Fierce and fast, and defending their lands even from birth."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Found either perched on walls or in green cocoons which hatch quickly when Hornet approaches.<br>
Kindanirs fly in short bursts and attempt to close in on Hornet before attacking with a large flurry of slashes in her direction that last for 1.5 seconds. Often dashes backwards after missing their attack if Hornet is close.<br>
The flurry comboes Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is hit at any point during the attack.

== Location ==
Kindanirs can be found exclusively in [[Lost Verdania]].
